  "phoneNote": "The warm photography and serif typography suit the shop, but the oversized opening-hours chart makes visitors scroll an entire screen before reaching the products.",

  "fixes": [
    "Replace the opening-hours chart with a compact schedule, grouping weekdays with identical hours, and place the product selection immediately after the hero.",
    "Bring Koper and the street address into the hero near the directions button so visitors understand the location without reaching the bottom.",
    "Use a distinct olive-oil product photograph instead of repeating the hero image, and distribute the three desktop product cards evenly across the content width."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop, product section: the olive-oil card repeats the exact hero photograph."
  ]
